Their preference for heritage and craftsmanship aligns directly with the advertiser's core values, and they match publishers pub_004 and pub_005.

The Sustainability Buyer values supply chain transparency and artisanal sourcing over mass-produced fast fashion, directly connecting to handcrafted Florentine leather goods. They can be effectively targeted on publisher pub_016.

The Gifter looks for impressive, high-AOV statement pieces with premium presentation, which fits custom-made luxury handbags. They align with the affluent demographics on publishers pub_004 and pub_005.
